data.long_meaning: The name Fariba is of Persian origin, derived from the Persian words 'far' meaning 'gentle' and 'iba' meaning 'beautiful'. This name is often given to girls in Persian and other Muslim cultures to reflect their gentle and lovely nature. The name Fariba carries the meaning “Gentle, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fariba usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
